name: post_mail_send
description: Send an email over SendGrid's Web API. Logs the outbound message, resolves subject/body from the active template version when template_id is given, and drops (does not deliver) mail to globally suppressed recipients. (POST /v3/mail/send)

from.description: The 'from' email address used to deliver the message. This address should be a verified sender in your account.

subject.description: The global or 'message level' subject of your email. Required unless a template with a subject defined is used.

body.description: The content of your email. When template_id is set and body is omitted, the active template version's html_content is used.

template_id.description: An email template ID. A template that contains a subject and content - either text or html - will override any subject and content values specified at the message level.

categories.description: An array of category names for this message. Each category name may not exceed 255 characters. A comma-separated string is also accepted.
